at2Validation.notRequiredReason: IRUN below 8 or automatic StealthChop calibration disabled

nearField.motorNoiseMetric: loudest telemetry-confirmed >=90% commanded-velocity gate, minus adjacent-idle A-weighted power; qualification uses the conservative 95% bootstrap upper bound

totalRecordedSound.confidenceScope: median/p95 bounds are per-window 95%, not simultaneous profile coverage; whole-STEP maximum is a screening statistic, not a confidence bound
totalRecordedSound.limitation: A raw exceedance does not identify room versus motor noise; whole-STEP ~100 ms screening is not a validated audibility guarantee

verify.acceptance: broadband: conservative 95% upper bound from every sustained gate with stable adjacent idle; tonal: >= 6.0 dB above both idle windows and repeated within 12.5 Hz; rho additionally requires every raw motion and adjacent idle upper bound and whole-STEP ~100 ms maximum under the tier

whole_step_transient.limitation: Conservative ~100 ms FFT-power screening, not a validated audibility guarantee; raw noise does not establish motor attribution

rejected_candidates.rejectionReason: not correlated across enough adjacent-idle gates

errors.message: Coarse approach did not find a sustained stall
